success.title: Welcome Back!
success.message: You've successfully signed in to your account.

invalid credentials.title: Sign In Failed
invalid credentials.message: The email or password you entered is incorrect. Please check your credentials and try again.
solutions: Double-check your email address for typos
Make sure Caps Lock is off when entering your password
Try resetting your password if you're unsure

account locked.title: Account Temporarily Locked
account locked.message: Your account has been temporarily locked due to multiple failed sign-in attempts.
solutions: Wait 15 minutes before trying again
Use the 'Forgot Password' option to reset your password
Contact support if the issue persists

email not verified.title: Email Not Verified
email not verified.message: Please verify your email address before signing in. Check your inbox for a verification link.
solutions: Check your email inbox (and spam folder)
Click the verification link in the email
Request a new verification email if needed

user not found.title: Account Not Found
user not found.message: We couldn't find an account with that email address. Please check your email or create a new account.
solutions: Double-check your email address
Try creating a new account if you don't have one
Contact support if you believe this is an error

network error.title: Connection Problem
network error.message: We're having trouble connecting to our servers. Please check your internet connection.
solutions: Check your internet connection
Try refreshing the page
Wait a few minutes and try again

server error.title: Service Temporarily Unavailable
server error.message: Our servers are experiencing issues. Please try again in a few minutes.
solutions: Wait 5-10 minutes and try again
Check our status page for updates
Contact support if the problem continues

unknown error.title: Something Went Wrong

solutions: Try refreshing the page

Include uppercase and lowercase letters
Add numbers and special characters
Avoid common words or personal information
